newsitem.title: USA: Berger Holdings reports Q4 revenues.
newsitem.headline: Berger Holdings reports Q4 revenues.

text.p: Berger Holdings Limited said on Wednesday its revenue of $4,902,000 for the quarter ending December 31 1996 compared with $3,371,000 for the comparable 1995 quarter is an increase of $1,531,000.
For the 12 months, revenue was $19,746,000 compared with $15,647,000, up $4,099,000 or 26 percent.
A company spokesman said a more detailed earnings report will be available at a later date.

Berger Holdings, the parent company of Berger Building Products, was founded in 1874 and is a manufacturer of roof drainage products and solid vinyl siding used primarily in the remodeling and renovation market.
